recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-47337 unless future generated output refresh checks identify a non-authoritative artifact issue.
issue_request: FHIR-47337 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification R6 FHIR-core Subscription issue asking to add Device as a Subscription.managingEntity target for server-to-server notifications; its final resolution also added Group for family groups of patients.
initial_application: The requested target profiles were applied before this reconciliation by commit 910bea45a10721840e3f8d75b58b7522fb783637, which added Device and Group targetProfile entries to source/subscription/structuredefinition-Subscription.xml. Jira linked PR HL7/fhir#3967 as the application vehicle, and that PR was merged on 2025-11-09.
additional_context: Subscription is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. The FHIR-I 2025-03-31 block-vote minutes record approval of the Subscription block vote including FHIR-47337, and the Zulip block-vote announcement lists the same issue without conflicting discussion. FHIR-47340 concerns the same element's definition text and was already represented by a separate no-change audit commit on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the combined branch already contains the authoritative source change and did not yet have an Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-47337.

related_jiras.note: Concerns the same Subscription.managingEntity element's definition text, but it is already represented on the combined branch and does not affect the target-profile decision audited here.
